name: solution-explorer
description: Solution Explorer-style file tree in a side pane: projects from .sln/.slnx, git status, and the files Claude touched this session

hide.title: Also hide
hide.description: Comma-separated names, *.ext patterns or relative paths to hide in addition to the defaults and the root .gitignore (e.g. TestResults, *.user, docs/old).

gitStatus.title: Git status marks
gitStatus.description: Run git.exe status in the root when the pane opens, on refresh and after each turn, and mark changed files.

maxEntries.title: Max entries per folder
maxEntries.description: A folder with more entries shows the first N and a '… +K more' row.
